families.name: neutral
families.usageIntent: Surfaces, text, borders, disabled structure, and dense enterprise hierarchy.

families.name: blue
families.usageIntent: Official product Primary source family for interaction, focus, and information where semantically mapped.

families.name: green
families.usageIntent: Current success candidate; never a sole status cue.

families.name: red
families.usageIntent: Danger and error outcomes with redundant non-color cues.

families.name: amber
families.usageIntent: Warning and attention outcomes with approved foreground relationships.

families.name: orange
families.usageIntent: Possible warning, attention, or chart family if distinct from amber and yellow.

families.name: yellow
families.usageIntent: Possible caution or chart family with explicit foreground pairing rules.

families.name: indigo
families.usageIntent: Advanced, AI, and premium contexts; not a core status semantic.

families.name: purple
families.usageIntent: AI, automation, and innovation contexts; not a default marketing color.

families.name: teal
families.usageIntent: Analytics, information, and data-heavy contexts with collision testing against success.

families.name: pink
families.usageIntent: Possible user-generated accent or chart family; not a marketing default.

categories.name: primary
categories.intent: Highest-priority product action or emphasis; not synonymous with a hue.

categories.name: secondary
categories.intent: Lower-emphasis product action or supporting emphasis.

categories.name: accent
categories.intent: Non-status emphasis, categorization, or user-selected identity.

categories.name: success
categories.intent: Completed or positive outcome with text, icon, or structure.

categories.name: error
categories.intent: Invalid or failed state; relationship to current danger semantics must be approved.

categories.name: info
categories.intent: Neutral explanatory status that is not a primary action.

categories.name: surface
categories.intent: Layered containers and grouped regions independent of shadow.

categories.name: text
categories.intent: Readable foreground hierarchy by purpose and emphasis.

categories.name: interactive
categories.intent: Rest, hover, active, selected, and visited behavior where meaningful.

categories.name: focus
categories.intent: Keyboard focus indication independent of selection and hover.

categories.name: selection
categories.intent: Persistent selected state distinct from keyboard focus.

categories.name: overlay
categories.intent: Scrims and occlusion with compositing and forced-colors rules.

categories.name: disabled
categories.intent: Unavailable state that retains legibility and a non-color cue.

categories.name: inverse
categories.intent: Foreground and surface pairs for opposite-luminance contexts.

categories.name: muted
categories.intent: Lower-emphasis content that still meets its declared contrast obligation.

categories.name: data
categories.intent: Categorical analytics series 01–11 with redundant labels, shapes, patterns, or a data table.
